STATE NATIONALIST REFORM | Strategic Operations - Technical Manifest

Description

High-performance Single Page Application (SPA) focused on asset protection, jurisdictional standing, and constitutional wealth insulation. The site utilizes a "paramilitary-corporate" aesthetic to convey authority, featuring interactive data visualizations and secure intelligence resources.

Tech Stack

Core: Vanilla HTML5 / ES6+ JavaScript (Modular logic)

Styling: Tailwind CSS (Utility-first, bundled via CDN)

Visuals: - Chart.js (Interactive asset insulation bar charts)

Plotly.js (Interactive Sankey diagrams for jurisdictional flow)

Video: Rumble Embed (Lazy-loaded for performance)

Forms: FormSubmit.co integration with custom client-side validation

Tracking: Google Tag Manager (G-C2153TK33Z)

SEO & Metadata Strategy

Primary Keywords: Asset Protection, Constitutional Law, Private Equity, Trust Protocol, 98-Series Indenture, Jurisdictional Standing.

Structured Data: JSON-LD Organization schema implemented for high-authority search indexing.

Social Graph: Full Open Graph (OG) and Twitter Card support for strategic link previews.

Design System

Palette:

Primary Red: --pac-red (#B91C1C) - "Action/Alert"

Deep Navy: --pac-navy (#0F172A) - "Authority/Background"

Bone White: --pac-bone (#F8FAFC) - "Clarity/Readability"

Typography:

Headers: Oswald (Impact, all-caps)

Body: Inter (Modern, high-legibility)

Navigation Architecture

The application uses MapsTo(viewId) to toggle visibility across four primary operational sectors:

Mission (#mission): Strategic briefing, hero video, and progress indicators.

Funding (#funding): Asset insulation data visualization (Chart.js).

Standing (#standing): Sankey diagram (Plotly.js) showing the transition from public liability to private authority.

Vault (#vault): Intelligence resource grid for 98-series protocols.

Operational Logic

State Management: In-memory navigation state with scroll-reset functionality.

Lazy Initialization: Heavy visual components (Charts/Plotly) initialize only upon view activation to optimize First Contentful Paint (FCP).

Security: CSRF protection via FormSubmit, honeypot potential, and secure link attributes (rel="noopener").

Inquiry System

Primary Endpoint: https://formsubmit.co/SNR_2026@proton.me

Fields: Name, Secure Email, Strategic Enquiry.

Flow: Direct POST with custom redirect headers for seamless UX.

Performance Targets

Fully mobile-responsive (fluid widths, no fixed pixels).

Accessibility-compliant (SR-only labels, ARIA roles, semantic header hierarchy).

Minimal external dependencies for rapid load times in low-bandwidth operational environments.
